experiences.title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer
experiences.description:
Building and operating agentic platforms for food and beverage businesses, ingesting cross-platform stock, sales, events, and operational data so each tenant's agent works from a real understanding of the business it runs.

Shipped and now run a production storefront and ordering backend on Next.js and Cloudflare Workers, covered by 345 tests. Cut page weight from 23.2 MB to 1.37 MB and desktop LCP from 7.2s to 2.5s by replacing runtime image delivery with a build-time pipeline, and capped the public write path per client IP so no address reaches the database or the logs.

Also building a patient retention and follow-up platform for allied health clinics: physiotherapy, RMT, kinesiology, and dental. It reads the practice management database directly and runs structured outreach off it, filling cancelled appointment slots from a ranked patient list, pulling bookings forward when an earlier slot opens, and prompting patients who are overdue for follow-up care. The revenue is already sitting in the patient list; the system's job is to stop it leaking. Multi-tenant with per-tenant database isolation, identity federated across three providers, and Terraform-managed infrastructure. Built and tested for a first dental clinic, not yet deployed.

experiences.title: Lead Cloud Engineer
experiences.description:
Architected an Azure ingestion and scoring pipeline across six services (Logic Apps, Functions, Container Instances, Container Registry, Blob Storage, Static Web Apps) that turns five live international data feeds into comparable country-level development scores: 216 countries, 28 indicators, 35 years of history.

Made a failed run incapable of overwriting good data. The frontend reads nothing but a versioned three-file JSON contract, published behind schema validation, so a broken pipeline leaves the last known-good snapshot in place rather than replacing it with a partial one.

Led a four-person team through PR review and weekly syncs, and audited the published output against what the pipeline claimed about itself. The audit caught a saturating scorer that had pinned one pillar to a perfect score for 182 of 216 countries, before any of it reached stakeholders.

experiences.title: Security Analyst
experiences.description:
Triaging and investigating security incidents across 7+ client environments, concentrated on IAM access controls, authentication telemetry, and cloud misconfigurations.

Reviewing Microsoft Entra ID logging and access policy, and tracing account and device compromises back to the control gap that allowed them rather than closing at the alert.

Translating open-source intelligence into KQL detection rules in Microsoft Sentinel, so a technique seen in the wild becomes coverage in a client tenant before it is used against one.

experiences.title: Security Operations Intern
experiences.description:
Running incident response in a client environment at roughly eight cases a day, from triage through containment and writeup.

Designing and tuning SIEM alert rules in Microsoft Sentinel to strengthen identity controls and reduce unauthorized access risk.

Conducting third-party risk management assessments to bound the security and legal exposure carried in through vendors.

experiences.title: IT Operations Intern
experiences.description:
Engineered a Bash telemetry agent to automate device log collection and centralize endpoint data in Azure, improving monitoring visibility across 5 clinic environments.

Maintained ISO 27001 and SOC 2 compliance documentation to uphold data protection standards in a regulated healthcare IT environment.
